meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "search memory", "what do you remember about X", "check claude-mem", "mem search", "find past observations", "what did we do last session", or wants prior-session context about a project, decision, file, or task. Searches the user's Claude-Mem (cmem.ai) memory.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索历史记忆，找回之前的对话和项目背景
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要查阅过去的会话记录来继续工作。
copy.tagline_en: Search past memories to retrieve prior conversations and project context.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to look back at previous chat records to continue your work.

howto.what: 装上这个技能后，当你问起之前做过的事，Claude 会去搜索你的 Claude-Mem 记忆库。它会先列出一份带编号的搜索结果索引，再看相关时间线，最后只取筛选后那几条的完整记录来回答。
howto.when: 当用户询问之前会话的内容，如“上次怎么解决 X 的”“上周发生了什么”，或要求搜索记忆时触发。

say.text: 我们上次怎么解决登录报错的？
say.note: Claude 会去记忆库搜索相关记录并回答。

say.text: 查一下 claude-mem 里关于认证的观察。
say.note: 触发搜索，Claude 会列出索引并筛选结果。

say.text: 上周我们做过哪些决策？
say.note: Claude 会按时间搜索并汇总决策记录。

howto.what_en: When the user asks about past work, Claude will search their Claude-Mem memory database. It first shows a numbered index of matching results, then checks the surrounding timeline, and finally fetches full records for only the filtered IDs to answer.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about previous sessions, e.g. 'How did we solve X last time?' or 'What happened last week?', or asks to search memory.

say_en.text: How did we fix the login error last time?
say_en.note: Claude will search the memory database and answer.

say_en.text: Check claude-mem for observations about authentication.
say_en.note: This triggers a search and filters results.

say_en.text: What decisions did we make last week?
say_en.note: Claude will search and summarize decision records.
